newsitem.title: USA: Microware falls on warning of Q3 loss.
newsitem.headline: Microware falls on warning of Q3 loss.

text.p: Shares of Microware Systems Corp fell 18 percent on Tuesday after the company said it expects to report a net loss in its third fiscal quarter.
"They missed their quarter," said Mary McCaffrey, an analyst for Alex. Brown, adding "I think the (future quarter) estimates will be revised downward."
Shares of Microware were trading off 2-3/4 to 12-1/4.
Late Monday, Microware said it expected to report a loss for its fiscal third quarter ended December 31 of $0.03 to $0.04 a share compared with a profit of $0.02 last year.
According to First Call, the consensus of analysts' estimates for the quarter was a profit of $0.05 a share.
The company said it "optimistic" about the fiscal fourth quarter, but McCaffrey said she expects a couple of choppy quarters for Microware.
"What you lost in December just doesn't add onto the March quarter," McCaffrey said.
The company said its designs will be used for Internet products, but McCaffrey said she does not expect royalties from those deals until the second half of the year.
Microware provides real-time operating system software and development tools for communications and industrial products.
